title: WordPress stats
description: Site-scoped daily views, visitors and seven-day chart. Requires the included OAuth helper and authenticated feed. Authorize only stats for your own selected WordPress.com-connected site. Setup: see this package's INSTALL.md in the public source release. Add an approved public source URL before submitting. Configure actual service URLs and credentials locally after import; never upload them to Workshop.
changelog: Initial public release; portable example URLs and documented local setup.
